title: Tere bina main

lines.text: Teri aatma se mujhko bhar de prabhu X 4
Teri raho par mujhko chalaya Yeshu X 4
Tera beta banakar kareeb liya X 4
Sare papon ko dhokar shuddh kiya X 4
Tera anugrah mere liye kaafi hai prabhu X 4
Teri aatma se mujhko bhar de prabhu
Teri raho par mujhko chalaya Yeshu
Sare papon ko dhokar shuddh kiya

chords:
[Verse 1]
Tere bina main
Kuch bhi nahin hoon
Tere bina main adhoora hoon
Teri aatma se mujhko bhar de prabhu X 4

[Verse 2]
Duniya ke bheed mein
Khoya hua tha
Tune mujhe dund liya
Teri raho par mujhko chalaya Yeshu X 4

[Verse 3]
Main kya hoon prabhu
Jo tune mujhe
Tere pyar se apna liya
Tera beta banakar kareeb liya X 4

[Verse 4]
Main jo gunaho mein
Dooba hua tha
Tune mujhe bacha liya
Sare papon ko dhokar shuddh kiya X 4

[Verse 5]
Ab main kyon daroo
Tu jo hai saath
Sada ke liye tune kaha
Tera anugrah mere liye kaafi hai prabhu X 4

[CHORUS]
Teri aatma se mujhko bhar de prabhu
Teri raho par mujhko chalaya Yeshu
Tera beta banakar kareeb liya
Sare papon ko dhokar shuddh kiya
